title: American Suzuki Motor Corp. Recalls KingQuad ATVs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Some KingQuad ATV's plastic fuel tanks were improperly manufactured and can develop a fuel leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 29,000.

title: Atico International USA Recalls Holiday Rattle Baby Slippers Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walgreens
summary: The internal stuffing and rattle inside the slippers decorative figures can be pulled out, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 57,000.

title: Camp Nod Lantern Nightlights Recalled Due to Shock and Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at The Land of Nod
summary: An electrical short circuit can occur in the nightlight's wiring, posing a risk of fire or shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 9,700.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Sunsations Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The hooded sweatshirts have drawstrings through the hood which can pose a strangulation or entrapment hazard to children. Units: About 3,600.

title: Kid O Products Recalls Wooden Puzzles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The knobs attached to the puzzle fruits can come loose, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,400 units.

title: Rocky Mountain Bicycles Recalled by Procycle Due to Fall Injury Hazard
summary: The front fork steering tube can break, posing a fall injury hazard. Units: About 325.

title: Wall Mount Fireplaces Recalled by Southern Enterprises Due to Fire and Fall Hazards; Sold Exclusively by Home Shopping Network
summary: Heat from the operating unit causes the plastic mounting screws to deform causing the unit to fall from the wall, posing a fall and fire hazard. Units: About 6,000.

title: Baja Motorsports Recalls Dirt Bikes Sold Exclusively at Pep Boys Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: Fuel can leak from the fuel tank, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,300.

title: Fun World Recalls Little Pet Vet and Dr. Littles Halloween Costumes with Toy Stethoscopes Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The costumes are sold with a toy stethoscope accessory. The plastic ear pieces at the end of the stethoscope can be pulled off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,800.

title: Global Industrial Recalls Workbench Components Due To Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: Misrouted wiring in the electrical outlets on the workbench risers, aprons and shelves, and reverse polarity in some workbench power cords pose an electric shock hazard. Units: About 5,000.

title: Stanley Security Solutions Announces Recall of Door Locksets; Failure of Latches Could Lead to Entrapment in an Emergency
summary: The latches can fail and the door cannot be unlocked from the inside, posing an entrapment hazard. This failure could lead to the inability to vacate a location in an emergency. Units: About 63,100.

title: Sunbeam Products Recalls Wine Openers Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold by QVC
summary: The wine bottles can break when opened with the recalled opener, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 159,000.

title: Sanus Elements Surge Protectors Recalled by Milestone AV Technologies Due to Shock Hazard
summary: Improper grounding of the case and inadequate insulation for the circuit breaker poses an electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,500.

title: Sunjoy Industries Recalls Outdoor Wood Burning Fireplaces Sold Exclusively at Lowe's Stores Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The decorative bronze powder coat finish on the fireplace chimney can ignite during use, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 20,000 in the United States and 400 in Canada.

title: AOSOM Recalls Wooden Playpens Due to Choking and Laceration Hazards
summary: The wooden playpen can break, split and/or crack at points where screws and other hardware are located. Small, broken wood pieces and hardware from the playpen can pose a risk of choking and laceration hazards to children. In addition, an unstable playpen can fall over onto a child, posing an entrap

title: IKEA Recalls Coffee/Tea Makers Due to Burn and Laceration Hazards
summary: Pressure from the metal pot holder against the coffee/tea maker can cause the glass to break unexpectedly, posing burn and laceration hazards. Units: About 94,000 in the U.S. and 34,000 in Canada.

title: Liebherr Recalls Built-In Refrigerators Due to Injury Hazard; Door Can Detach
summary: The refrigerator's door can detach, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,702 units.

title: Manhattan Group Recalls Parents Wooden Activity Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Wooden pegs on the xylophone activity can come loose, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 400.

title: Rattles Recalled by Rhino Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The hard plastic C-links on both ends of the rattles' soft plastic chain can break, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 14,000 in the United States and 14,000 in Canada.

title: Burlington Coat Factory Recalls Slow Cookers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The slow cooker's control panel can overheat and melt, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 7,460.

title: Baby Jogger LLC Recalls Baby Jogger Jump Seats Due to Fall Hazard
summary: If the Jump Seat does not properly lock into place, the Jump Seat could disengage from the stroller allowing the child to fall out. Units: About 1,545 (U.S.) and about 450 (Canada).

title: Dick's Sporting Goods Recalls Fitness Resistance Tubes Due to Contusion and Laceration Hazards
summary: The plastic clip that attaches the resistance tube to the handle can break during use causing the tubing, handle or fragments of the plastic clip to strike the user. This poses a contusion and laceration hazard. Units: About 229,000.

title: FAB/Starpoint Recalls Circo Beaded Door Curtains Due to Risk of Strangulation; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: Strangulations can occur when a child plays with the beaded strands by wrapping them around their necks or by creating loops in which they can insert their heads. Also, children can get entangled in the strands, which are prone to entangle, just by running through the doorway. Units: 79000.

title: Lennox Hearth Products Recalls Natural Gas Log Set Burner Assemblies Due to Risk of Carbon Monoxide Poisoning
summary: A crack can develop at the gas valve connection allowing natural gas to leak while the burner is in use, posing a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning. Units: About 3,200.

title: Tommy Bahama Recalls Mini-Tin Candle Travel Sets Due to Burn Hazards
summary: The candle flame can spread from the wick to the wax causing a larger than expected flame, posing a risk of burns to consumers. Units: About 1,800.

title: Kingsman Fireplaces Recalls Gas Fireplaces Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Delayed ignition can cause the fireplace's propane gas to explode and break or shatter the glass door. This poses a laceration hazard to consumers nearby. Units: About 40.

title: Lasko Recalls Box Fans Due To Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical failure in the fan's motor poses a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 4.8 million units.

title: Gerber Legendary Blades Recalls Combo Axe Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The knife in the axe handle can come out when the axe is used for chopping or hammering, posing a laceration hazard to the user. Units: About 103,000.

title: Ocean Technology Systems Recalls Guardian Full-Face Diving Masks Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The purge assembly on the diving mask can disengage from the regulator, resulting in loss of air to the diver. This poses a drowning hazard to the consumer. Units: About 1,700 in the U.S. and 80 in Canada.

title: Scotch Corporation Recalls Instant Power Toilet Bowl Restorer
summary: The contents can leak from the cap when the bottle is turned on its side. When this happens, the cleaner can come into contact with consumers and property, posing a risk of chemical burns and irritation to the skin and eyes. Units: About 74,760.

title: Second Infant Death Prompts Re-Announcement of Delta Enterprise "Safety Peg" Drop-Side Crib Recall
summary: Missing safety pegs can create a situation where the crib's drop-side rail disengages from the track. This can create a hazardous space in which an infant can become entrapped and suffocate. Units: About 985,000.

title: Kawasaki Motor Recalls Backpack Blowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The gasoline tank can split and leak fuel, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,400 in the United States and 100 in Canada.

title: Maruyama U.S. Recalls Backpack Blowers and Mister Dusters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The gasoline tank can split and leak fuel, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 18,000 in the United States and 750 in Canada.

title: Girls' Jeans for Toddlers Recalled by Parigi Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Decorative rhinestones and sequins on the jeans' pockets can pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,600 units.

title: Pogo Sticks Recalled by Bravo Sports Due to Risk of Serious Injury
summary: The bottom of the pogo stick's frame tube can break or come apart and a pin holding the spring in place can break, posing laceration and fall hazards to consumers. Units: About 169,000.

title: American Suzuki Motor Corp. Recalls QuadSport ATVs Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The regulator/rectifier circuit board can fail and cause the engine to stall during riding due to an insufficient battery charge, increasing the risk of a crash. Units: About 1,350.

title: Matilda Jane Recalls Girl's Chelsa Dress Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The buttons can come off, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 1,500.

title: Mowers Recalled by The Toro Company Due to Injury Hazard
summary: Mowers with the optional deluxe seat have an operator presence switch built into the seat that can activate the mower when the operator vacates the seat, posing an injury hazard from the blade to the operator and anyone in the vicinity of the mower. Units: About 3700 U.S. and 109 in Canada.

title: Exmark Recalls Pioneer S-Series Mowers Due to Crash Hazard
summary: Welds on the motion control linkage can fail and cause the driver to lose control of the machine, resulting in a crash hazard. Units: About 750 products.
